question: For normalized zonal scalar harmonics Q_n=U_n(cos chi)/sqrt(2*pi^2) on unit S3, what exact Gaunt selection rules, nonlinear product coefficients, hard-cutoff square leakage norms, and iterated projected-cubic convolution residuals occur for the declared finite coefficient packets?

upstream_results.role: pins the unit-S3 scalar-harmonic convention and its explicit non-HDA boundary; this calculation adds only zonal scalar convolution data

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Chapter 18, Orthogonal Polynomials
primary_sources.used_for: Chebyshev/Gegenbauer U_n identities underlying the zonal product rule
primary_sources.not_used_for: a complete S3 scalar basis, nonlinear ADM constraints, or cutoff closure

primary_sources.source: J. J. Halliwell and S. W. Hawking, Origin of Structure in the Universe, Phys. Rev. D 31 (1985) 1777
primary_sources.not_used_for: a transfer of perturbative action, gauge, initial-state, or inflationary assumptions

declared_basis_and_cutoff.measure: dV=sin(chi)^2 dchi dOmega_2 on unit S3; integral Q_n Q_m=delta_nm
declared_basis_and_cutoff.product: U_a U_b=sum_{j=0}^{min(a,b)} U_{a+b-2j}; Q_a Q_b=(2*pi^2)^(-1/2) sum_{j=0}^{min(a,b)} Q_{a+b-2j}
declared_basis_and_cutoff.triple_gaunt: integral Q_a Q_b Q_c=(2*pi^2)^(-1/2) iff c belongs to {a+b,a+b-2,...,abs(a-b)}, and zero otherwise
declared_basis_and_cutoff.hard_cutoff: P_N retains Q_0 through Q_N after every declared projected operation

coefficient_packets.purpose: the smallest nonconstant one-mode packet whose square emits Q_4 beyond N=2
a mixed packet with both Q_3 and Q_4 nonlinear leakage
a signed packet demonstrating that exact leakage and iterated residuals need not be positive coefficientwise

exact_plan: hash-verify the scalar-derived harmonic result and its scoped verdict
verify zonal orthonormality, U_a U_b product identities, and the triple-Gaunt selection rule for declared finite test degrees

compute each packet's full square, P_N square, discarded quadratic-mode coefficients and (1-P_N) square norm; verify the exact identity integral phi^3=<phi,P_N phi^2> for phi in P_N; then record the distinct projected iterated-cubic convolution residual
emit exact SymPy strings together with 50-digit numerical renderings for all packet norms and cubic quantities
leave transverse SVT, full ADM cubic constraints, lapse/shift brackets, Jacobi/HDA/BFV and all physical outputs null
